scope: Native CLI TTY rendering and approval review

human_terminal_contract.streams: assistant text is written to stdout; tool progress, actual provider token counts, session history, approvals, and run status are written as readable terminal output
human_terminal_contract.file_approval: bounded before/after diff is shown before accepting the durable native operation ID
human_terminal_contract.process_approval: profile, working directory, executable, literal arguments, timeout, and environment variable names are shown
human_terminal_contract.terminal_safety: control characters in model response text are removed before terminal rendering

verification.build: Release xmind_cli and unified xmind targets compiled successfully with Visual Studio 18 CMake
synthetic_cases: actual assistant text rendered without NDJSON event envelopes
provider-supplied prompt/completion/total token counters rendered without estimates
native create_file proposal diff and exact operation ID displayed before /allow
approved file content and succeeded native tool result verified
existing machine-readable JSON approval contract remained passing

limitations: This checkpoint validates the CLI terminal renderer, not a new webpage or VS Code UI change.
Full-screen terminal interface and interactive graph/plan views remain separate work.
